Best of Majima - Ryu ga Gotoku: Goro Majima Karaoke All Time Best Collection - () is a CD album released on December 7, 2017. It was bundled with Yakuza Kiwami 2: Limited Edition DX Pack Best of Majima Set () and sold separately as well. It includes fourteen songs from the karaoke mini-game and two versions of the Majima Construction Anthem. Most songs feature Hidenari Ugaki performing as Goro Majima along with others.
Yasuo Sodachi has a dojo next to the Children's Park. He's not doing very well, so Saejima has to help him. How? By training apprentices. You can only train one apprentice at a time.
The Dining Challenge is a recurring challenge in the Yakuza series.

Fishing is a minigame introduced in Yakuza 3 and returning in subsequent games. It is divided into Sea Fishing and River Fishing, the latter of which was introduced in Yakuza 5. It is part of the Minigames Challenge. Completion usually requires catching every type of fish, including trash like broken umbrellas, coral, and metal barrels.

Difficulty is a game setting present in all Like a Dragon titles from Yakuza 2 onward. It changes enemy attack patterns, general behavior, and how much damage they deal and take. In Yakuza Kiwami 2, Judgment, and Lost Judgment, bosses have the same health and defense across all difficulties.

Character stories are a game mechanic introduced in Ryu Ga Gotoku Online. A character story is a type of substory which focuses on a particular character and consists of three episodes. Each episode initiates a battle and yields a Clear reward and a Completion reward, as well as some EXP, money, item cards, or materials. Character stories cost stamina to play. Typically, a character story follows a character or characters through a short scenario divided into three parts offering further development on their daily life or a particular incident they were involved in.
